name: durable-spec-development
description: End-to-end durable spec workflow: import a structured plan into a task tracker (ClickUp, Linear, Jira, Asana, Notion, GitHub Projects, or markdown fallback) as a ticket hierarchy, ship every actionable subtask as its own stacked pull request, and address unresolved PR review comments — driving each PR to merge-ready through multi-round bot and human review.
